misconceptions.description: Trusting a single overall accuracy number.
misconceptions.trigger: learner says '92 % accurate, so it works'
misconceptions.feedback: Ask: accurate for whom? Look for results broken down by group.

misconceptions.description: Believing more data always fixes bias.
misconceptions.trigger: learner adds more of the same data to fix a gap
misconceptions.feedback: More of the same data does not help the missing group. Coverage of that group does.
